messages:
Marta (partnerships): Quick heads-up — NebulaEdge wants to stage GPU SKUs in the new reykjavik region next month. We need to lock marketplace entitlements + legal ok for SKUs.

Juan (cloud-partners): timeline? they asked for a soft launch week of Apr 20-26.

Marta (partnerships): yes that window. Primary asks: 1) marketplace listing entitlement approval, 2) quota for 8 x A100/40GB equivalent initially, 3) SI integration test slot with NebulaEdge on our private VPC.

Evan (infra): For quotas we'll need the exact SKU names and provisioning API payload. Can @Juan share the SKU IDs NebulaEdge provided?

Juan (cloud-partners): they sent these earlier, copying here:

```
{"skus": ["neb-a100-40gb-v1","neb-t4-16gb-ephemeral"], "region": "reykjavik-eu-nw", "initial_units": {"neb-a100-40gb-v1": 8, "neb-t4-16gb-ephemeral": 12}}
```

Jamal (solutions-eng): For the SI test we need credentials and a small sample deployment (k8s helm + nodeSelector). I can own a canary test if infra provides a sandbox namespace.

Evan (infra): I can spin up a sandbox namespace and pre-authorize NebulaEdge CI. ETA 2 business days once legal clears entitlements.

Priya (legal): Reviewing the marketplace T&Cs — two redlines: (1) data residency clause must explicitly permit customer-managed VPC not transiting partner analytics, (2) export control clause needs vendor attest. I'll ping legal ops and NebulaEdge for a confirmation doc. Expected turnaround 3 business days.

Nina (product): Also confirm SLAs we'll expose on the listing. We should avoid promising <100ms P95 for initial stage. Suggest: "SLA: best-effort low-latency, dedicated capacity available on request" and metric-based later.

Ryan (sales): Need approved pricing matrix to give prospects. Juan, can you nudge NebulaEdge for a staging price sheet that matches the SKUs above?

Juan (cloud-partners): pinged them just now. they said pricing sheet coming end of day tomorrow.

DevOps-Bot: deploy job queued: nebula-sandbox-provision -> job id 4632. Status: pending.

Marta (partnerships): Plan of record:
- Priya: complete legal attestation (3bd)
- Evan: sandbox + quota template (2bd after legal)
- Jamal: run SI canary test (1bd after sandbox)
- Juan: collect pricing & SKU confirmation (EOD tomorrow)
- Nina: finalize marketplace copy (after legal)

If anyone can't meet these, call it out now. /cc @Priya @Evan

Priya (legal): noted. I'll request the vendor attest and the data flow diagram from NebulaEdge — ask them to drop into the shared drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/nebula-reykjavik

Evan (infra): preparing quota request template. Example payload I'll submit:

```
POST /internal/quotas
{
  "region": "reykjavik-eu-nw",
  "requester": "partnerships/marta",
  "items": [{"sku":"neb-a100-40gb-v1","units":8}, {"sku":"neb-t4-16gb-ephemeral","units":12}],
  "justification": "partner staging for marketplace listing"
}
```

Marta (partnerships): thanks. I'll track in the partnership board and update partner. Filing as thread_ts 1758881234.

Ryan (sales): thumbs up. I'll hold back enterprise outreach until we have entitlements + price sheet.

Juan (cloud-partners): once pricing is in, I can draft the marketplace onboarding ticket.

DevOps-Bot: job 4632 status: in_progress -> provisioning nodes.

Marta (partnerships): perfect — small ask: if legal/infra complete this week we can still hit Apr 20 soft launch. Otherwise we shift 1 week out. I'll update timeline Friday.

Jamal (solutions-eng): will prep the canary helm chart and post instructions in this thread.

Marta (partnerships): thanks everyone :pray:
